units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 18:14">Targ. O. Gen. XVIII, 14</cite> (Y. <he>ז׳ חגא</he>, h. text <he>מועד</he>). Ib. II, 23 <he>הדא ז׳</he> this time (h. text <he>הפעם</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 18:7">Targ. Jer. XVIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 18:9">9</cite> <he>ז׳ … וז׳</he> at one time … another time.—
<cite ref="Chullin 105b:17">Ḥull. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>ליקבע לי מר ז׳ וכ׳</he> set me a term, and I shall pay.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:4">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>דקבעינן ז׳</he> that (in legal summons) a date is fixed for appearing in court.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ז׳ בתר ז׳</he> one term after the ofther (in case of failing to appear on the first summons).
<cite ref="Chagigah 4b:11">Ḥag. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>אזיל בלא זִימְנֵיה</he> dies before his destined time; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:4">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ז׳ חדא</he> once upon a time (introducing a story).—Pl. <he>זִמְנִין</he>, <cite ref="G00538"><he>זִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 23:17">Targ. Ex. XXIII, 17</cite>; a. e.—
Zeb. 94ᵇ, a. fr. ז׳ סגיאין many times.—ז׳—ז׳ at times … at other times.
<cite ref="Berakhot 20b:15">Ber. 20ᵇ</cite>, a. fr.—<he>מַשְׁכֵּן זִימְנָא</he> = h. <he>אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:43">Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 43</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 74:4">Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 4</cite> <he>זִמְנָיִךְ</he> = <he>משכני זי׳</he>.—
Targ. Jer. XLVII, 6 לבית ז׳ to thy destined home (the sheath; h. text הֵרָגְעִי!).—[Targ. Ps. CXLI, 4 בזמן משתיהון Ms (ed. בזמר בית מ׳) at their appointed banquets, v. preced. wds.]
